0.why: Ataconso.cpp process(): altura += getVoltage()*((4-(-4))/10) then clamped to ±4 octaves

1.why: Ataconso.cpp process(): timbreMs += getVoltage()*(TIMBRE_MS_MAX/10) then clamped to 0.1..20ms

comment: The panels in this plugin carry no control lettering, so every line here is written from the maker's source and tooltips. The frequency CV is deliberately not a volt-per-octave input; the source says so in a comment and scales it to the knob's own range instead. The refusal to retrigger while the pulse is high is written into the source on purpose, to copy a real 555 monostable.
